💪 Build: Statuesque Build
Tall and elegantly proportioned — a striking figure with balanced, elongated proportions that command visual attention through grace rather than bulk.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Statuesque Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Statuesque frame — tall, upright, elegant proportions with long vertical lines. Classical balance between shoulders and hips, body reads sculpted and poised. Female: shoulders level and open above a long waist, long neck, clean jaw with a defined chin, the chest line above a long drawn waist. Male: shoulders wide and squared, long neck, strong jaw, a broad flat chest on a long torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at classical height.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
